metadata.question: Does Australia show higher carbon monoxide concentration than Indonesia in October 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI CO (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO) - Date: October 2024 (2024-10-01 to 2024-10-31) - Location: Two country polygons for Australia and Indonesia 2. Masking strategy: - For CO data, use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.5 is typically recommended) - No cloud masking needed as this is atmospheric data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: CO concentration can be legitimately low (near 0) but typically ranges from 0.02-0.05 mol/m² for background - C1: If no images found for either location - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after QA filtering - C3: If results are None/NaN or outside realistic CO range (e.g., negative or extremely high >1 mol/m²) - A: If Australia CO > Indonesia CO - B: If Australia CO <= Indonesia CO ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Australia and Indonesia const australia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([113, -44, 154, -10]); const indonesia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([95, -11, 141, 6]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2024-10-01'; const endDate = '2024-10-31'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P CO data const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .select(['CO_column_number_density', 'qa_value']) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const australiaCol = collection.filterBounds(australia); const indonesiaCol = collection.filterBounds(indonesia); const ausSize = australiaCol.size().getInfo(); const indoSize = indonesiaCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Australia images: ${ausSize}`); console.log(`Indonesia images: ${indoSize}`); // Check if either collection is empty if (ausSize === 0 || indoSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for one or both locations"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Create composite with QA filtering function maskCO(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.5); return image.select('CO_column_number_density').updateMask(mask); } const australiaMean = australiaCol.map(maskCO).mean(); const indonesiaMean = indonesiaCol.map(maskCO).mean(); // 5. Calculate mean CO concentration with pixel count const ausStats = australiaMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: australia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const indoStats = indonesiaMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: indonesia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ausCO = ausStats['CO_column_number_density_mean']; const ausCount = ausStats['CO_column_number_density_count']; const indoCO = indoStats['CO_column_number_density_mean']; const indoCount = indoStats['CO_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`Australia: CO=${ausCO}, Pixels=${ausCount}`); console.log(`Indonesia: CO=${indoCO}, Pixels=${indoCount}`); // 6. Check for valid pixels if (ausCount === 0 || indoCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after QA filtering"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Validate results if (ausCO == null || indoCO == null || isNaN(ausCO) || isNaN(indoCO) || ausCO < 0 || indoCO < 0 || ausCO > 1 || indoCO > 1) { console.log("Invalid CO values detected"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 8. Compare and provide answer console.log(`Australia CO: ${(ausCO * 1e6).toFixed(2)} µmol/m²`); console.log(`Indonesia CO: ${(indoCO * 1e6).toFixed(2)} µmol/m²`); if (ausCO > indoCO) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
